pages.text: Weapons, staves and wands can roll $(item)sockets$(). Put a gem in at a smithing table; a Sigil of Socketing adds a socket. Armor takes no Apotheosis gems.
Armor has its own $(item)jeweler's sockets$(): combine a piece with a Socket Mount at an anvil, then with a gem cut at the Jeweler's Kit. One per piece.$(br2)Rings and necklaces carry gems too.
The $(item)Arcanist's Prism$() is a gem for staves and wands only: it adds spell power. Look for it in boss and dungeon loot.
